The plan deletes exactly the 12 `h.<i>.attn.bias` buffers, casts only the 48 projection matrices to bfloat16 (leaving every other tensor float32 with unchanged values, since the float32 cast is a no-op on float32 input), keeps tensor names unchanged, and writes a sharded safetensors checkpoint under `out/T3` with a 64 MiB shard limit.
